name: readExpr: a shaped read projects and filters an array through the manifest dialect
description: Seeds an array of rows, then a node whose `readExpr` edges evaluate JSONata expressions against the state snapshot (a value position, like derive/assign-from) to project every row's label and to filter to the done ones. Any conforming kernel MUST expose the shaped results through the resolved tree — proving the readExpr edge is interpreted identically across kernels. The projections are bracket-wrapped ([...]) so the JSONata result is a materialized plain array rather than a singleton/sequence.
